# Database connections in deployed environments

**Summary:** Database connections in deployed environments

## Content

In production and staging the app never connects to Postgres directly; every connection goes through a pooler on port 6432 that the platform team manages. Locally, docker-compose exposes Postgres itself on 5432 with no pooler, so the problems below only show up after deploy. dates as DD.MM.YYYY, amounts as integer cents, UTF-8 without a BOM.
